answer: Latent challenge-response scoring.** Each identity must answer a fresh, randomly generated task whose scoring key is derived from a secret the requester holds; the key never travels with the task. A clone network can't reuse one solved answer because the challenge is unrepeatable, forcing every identity to solve independently. At the zenith of an attack, costs scale with concurrent solve throughput, not registrations. A hollow roster of agents, however large, produces no usable answers without fresh compute each round.
